sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One production environment illustration for a clean comic medieval fantasy mobile game. Use reference ONLY for the approved illustration language and color separation, not its shop subject. Confident dark espresso outlines, purposeful simplified shapes, two or three crisp shadow values, broad painted highlights, restrained material detail. Looks hand-designed, no plastic shiny AI rendering, photoreal texture, microdetail, blurred airbrush or dramatic glow. PORTRAIT 3:4 image. One coherent FULL outdoor landscape viewed slightly from above at a natural human-scale distance. Real continuous ground extends right to all image edges; scene objects rooted on that ground. No floating island, cutaway soil, miniature model, tabletop, indoor room, pedestal, UI, frame, labels, text or characters. Composition must have depth: cool blue distance in upper 25%, meaningful recognizable location in middle 35–75%, broad ochre dirt path and simple foreground edge plants at bottom. Upper 28% deliberately calm with cool diffuse background and no visually busy props, because resources and heading will be overlaid there. A broad winding road occupies center, warm gold sunlight on wood and road contrasted with cool navy shadows and fresh grouped green foliage. Darker foliage at far edges frames the scene without obscuring the road. Clear and beautiful even when shrunk to phone size. Keep distinguishing location landmark centered around image y=56% and fully within middle 80% width. No tiny random decorations, no repetitive banners. OUTPOST: a stout small wooden palisade gate spanning the road at middle-left, an attractive timber watchtower at middle-right with a single red pennant and a blue shield mounted by its base. Golden dirt road passes through gate and curves toward foreground. Fresh bright grouped green trees left/right, pale chunky sandstone, distant gentle green hills and small cool blue castle silhouette. Sturdy grounded architecture, asymmetrical scenic composition, no exposed floating rock platform.
